subject: Phased handshake: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test cadence
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearpath.com>, Emily Wong <emily.wong@clearpath.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Phased handshake: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test cadence

Hi Sanjay / Emily —

Thanks again for taking the time today. To keep the intake efficient for both teams, we'd like to propose a phased "handshake" approach rather than one long session:

Phase A (30–45m): Controls overview + DPA redline Qs (Architecture + data flows)
Phase B (45m): Evidence walkthrough (SVTs, logs, retention) — we’ll drop an evidence index beforehand
Phase C (30m): Pen-test scoping / timing and any post-test readout cadence

This lets your folks join the phases relevant to them and keeps sessions short for engineers. Proposed slots (US/Eastern):
- Tue Dec 1, 09:00–10:00 ET (A + B condensed)
- Wed Dec 2, 16:00–17:00 ET (B + C) — late slot for East Coast ops
- Thu Dec 3, 12:00–13:00 ET (A only)

If none of those work, can you share two 1-hour windows that fit your security and legal teams? We plan to:
- Share SOC2 evidence index ahead of Phase B (SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx)
- Attach our standard DPA redline for your counsel to review (attached)
- Offer a short pen-test scope call the week following Phase B for final scheduling

Goal: gate the call series so we can move quickly through the DPA redline and evidence ask, and schedule the pen-test slot once scope is agreed.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx (draft), DPA-redline-v2.pdf

Thanks — will loop Ben for the evidence handoff plan.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment stubs: SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 rows); DPA-redline-v2.pdf (doc, redline)

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Phased handshake: SOC 2 + DPA + pen-test cadence

Vivek —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. The phased approach makes sense for us. A couple of notes from legal / security:
- Legal prefers we start with a 45m DPA + data-flow session to resolve the bulk of redlines up-front.
- Security wants the evidence walkthrough in a separate 60m slot so engineers can share terminal sessions if needed.

Our constraints (PT / EST folks):
- Tue Dec 1: free 08:30–10:00 PT (11:30–13:00 ET) — would cover a condensed A+B but would overlap lunch for some.
- Wed Dec 2: free 13:00–15:00 PT (16:00–18:00 ET) — works for B+C as you suggested.

Can we do:
- Wed Dec 2, 16:00–17:00 ET — Phase A (DPA + data flow) 45m, followed by 17:00–18:00 ET — Phase B (evidence walkthrough) 60m? We can combine internally but would prefer separate invites.

I attached our current internal attendee list and a single page of DPA comments to accelerate redline discussion.

Emily
Security Program Manager
ClearPath Financial

Thanks for the quick response and the attendee list, Emily. Two operational notes from our side:

2) We'll pre-populate the SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx with pointers to the artifacts we already have (Control IDs, export path, expected retention) and share it 24 hours before the Phase B slot.

Per Emily's suggestion, Vivek and I are OK with Wed Dec 2 as two back-to-back invites:
- 16:00–16:45 ET — Phase A (DPA + data flow)
- 17:00–18:00 ET — Phase B (evidence walkthrough)

If that works, I'll send calendar invites separately (we'll use separate invites so teams can RSVP just to the relevant phase).
